card.name: Small words inside dose quantity phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking or unit words in the middle of a quantity or rate phrase, such as 'period of', 'kg' in a weight band, 'per' before day, or 'times' before daily. Mostly in dosing text.

modes.label: Weight bands and units
modes.description: The unit 'kg' or a vial or body-weight term inside dosing tables.
modes.example: Concomitant Medications Dosage (Volume of Solution) of Maraviroc Based on Weight 10<< kg>> to <14 kg 14

modes.label: Rate and frequency words
modes.description: Words like per, times, daily, or of that sit inside a dose-per-time phrase.
modes.example: Increase the dosage in increments of up to 75 mg<< per>> day, as needed, using another ven

modes.label: Non-drug comparisons
modes.description: Comparison words in general text about amounts or percentages.

card.writes: It slightly favors words that continue a quantity phrase and lowers 'total' words.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in the middle of dose amounts and frequencies, like 'mg per day'.
